mapper.select: SELECT v.id AS voucher_id, v.shop_id, s.name AS shop_name, SUBSTRING_INDEX(s.images, ',', 1) AS shop_image, v.title, v.sub_title, v.pay_value, v.actual_value, sv.stock, sv.begin_time, sv.end_time FROM tb_voucher v INNER JOIN tb_seckill_voucher sv ON sv.voucher_id = v.id INNER JOIN tb_shop s ON s.id = v.shop_id WHERE v.type = 1 AND v.status = 1 ORDER BY sv.begin_time ASC, v.id DESC
